about_the_game:
Overview

Step into the haunting world of Legend of Krigz, a gripping horror survival experience set in a desolate, abandoned suburban town. You play as a specialist investigating the disappearance of an exploration team that ventured too far into a place they shouldn’t have. A government experiment gone wrong has unleashed a terror unlike any other—a monstrous, electricity-feeding predator known as Krigz.

Stay in the light or risk becoming the next victim. With limited resources, an adaptive enemy, and an environment where every flickering light could be a warning, survival is not guaranteed. Choose your approach: gather resources and set traps, or stay in the shadows and outmaneuver Krigz before it finds you.

Survival

Watch your stats

Cook your food

Key Features

  • Dynamic AI Creature – Krigz learns from your actions, adapting to your strategies and forcing you to constantly evolve your tactics.

  • Day/Night Cycle – Use the daylight to prepare, but once night falls, Krigz emerges to hunt.

  • Resource Management & Exploration – Scavenge for supplies, medkits and trap parts to increase your chances of survival.

  • Power-Based Threat Detection – Krigz feeds off electrical sources, making powered locations dangerous. Turning on lights may help you see, but it will also make you easier to find.

  • Multiple Endings – Your choices shape the outcome. Will you escape, defeat the creature, or uncover a deeper mystery?

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content
